messages.content: Good morning, thanks for your reply. Apologies, you didn't take the wrong supply, rather you removed our meter D06G508124 and put in its place smart meter 24J0493062. We've therefore corrected industry by installing 24J0493062 against our MPAN, but we now need you to put meter Z12NA12481 back against your MPAN, as this meter is still in situ and is supplying "THE OFFICE" on MPAN 1419851122005. Kind regards, Aaron

Hi team, 
Could you please clarify what you mean by re-instating the meter here as the new smart meter has already been installed with the MSN: 24J0493062 for the MPAN: 1419851122005. 

Additionally, if we do have the incorrect supply shouldn't the correct supply be ETd to us? Kindly clarify.

Good morning, I hope you're well. This is an escalation of crossed meters case CMC32061. Fuse Energy took the wrong supply from us after taking MPAN 1419851122005. Fuse then installed a smart meter for this supply but incorrectly removed meter D06G508124 (on our MPAN 1460001571848) instead of removing meter Z12NA12481. Meter Z12NA12481 is still in situ. Please could Fuse therefore reinstate this meter. We have updated our MPAN 1460001571848 to show meter 24J0493062.
